clauses.quote: ET 15/12 employees are those who work twelve months per year and are entitled to the same working conditions as all ET 15 bargaining unit members, except as specifically defined within this Agreement, and are paid on a special ET15/12 salary schedule.
clauses.notes: Defines a bargaining unit sub-group while granting substantive entitlements to working conditions and a specific pay schedule.

clauses.quote: ET 15/11 employees are those who work eleven months per year and are entitled to the same working conditions as all ET 15 bargaining unit members, except as specifically defined within this Agreement, and are paid on a special ET15/11 salary schedule.
